sampling_interpretation: Fixed deterministic hash design; record quota/population per year/market/bear stratum as design inclusion probability, not a claim of actual independent random draws. Rank SHA256('DF008_DOCUMENT_PILOT_V1:REVISION:'+receipt), take<=40. Actual29 candidates, no overflow. A matching corporate ID is only a possible relation, not a verified event family.
existing_documents: Keep and offline-revalidate DF0062 documents as parser controls, outside pilot success numerator when not selected. No forced substitution into60.

acquisition_proposal_not_authorization.request_order: Originals ascending frozen rank, then revisions ascending frozen rank; first2 originals are feasibility probes included in same budget. No replacement after content inspection.

collector: New independent version only. Disabled by default. OS process lock across run; persist request reservation before I/O; immutable full safe response bytes+SHA256; atomic event/cache/budget publication under one process lock with journal recovery; consumed unknown in-flight attempts are not refunded; persistent<=2 attempts per receipt; cache validates raw hash and budget lineage; no URLs/secret values in logs. perf_counter high-resolution completion wait>=3.10 with recheck, actual start timestamps and monotonic/UTC gap observations before send. Any observed gap<3.05 permanently stops this run; unknown clock response integrity/auth/quota conflicts stop, never reset budget. No retry for auth/quota/definitive missing-document status; at most1 for transient transport/server error.
source_gate: Rehash210 raw B001 pages, reproduce19319 unique rows/620originals/130revisions and exact302 old50 filter. No current master backfill. Verify existing2 ZIP hashes and known89 target cache absence/presence. Normalized record hashes retain independent source lineage.

identity_states.DOCUMENT_VERIFIED: Safe immutable response hash, ZIP and parsed XML whose official receipt identity matches requested receipt. Format success is not corporate or PIT approval.
identity_states.CORPORATE_IDENTITY_VERIFIED: Original document COMPANY-NAME explicit AREGCIK or equivalent official corporate-ID field equals8digit source corp_code; preserve legal name independently.
identity_states.HISTORICAL_SYMBOL_MAPPING_VERIFIED: Explicit labeled6digit stock-code evidence in contemporaneous original document or preexisting official historical evidence tied to same corporate ID/date. API current metadata code or AREGCIK alone never qualifies. Absent evidence=>NULL.
identity_states.EVENT_FAMILY_VERIFIED: Original primary body heading and structured planned-acquisition fields corroborate direct acquisition decision. Trust/disposal/completion/cancellation and ambiguous mixed bodies remain separate. Title/body mismatch preserved.
identity_states.PRICE_AND_SESSION_QUALIFIED: Separate evidence gate: complete relevant real RAW/ADJUSTED/index/session/action/halt and historical identity inputs; no new KIS calls or new price outcomes here. Existing consumed2 retain their old limited exploratory result but do not automatically satisfy this stricter historical-symbol gate. Absent inputs=>NULL.

historical_facts: Actual publication second timestamp NULL unless explicit reliable original source. Receipt date is not publication second. Actual acquisition time separate. Document corporate ID does not prove then-listing market, delisting/halt status or stock code. Explicit contemporaneous evidence only; otherwise NULL with exact missing evidence reason. No inferred current-survivor eligibility.
revision_lineage: Link only explicit parent receipt reference or an official correction-target initial filing date+corporate ID+family that uniquely resolves to one source original, with chronological consistency. Similar titles/dates alone insufficient. Ambiguous same-day roots or outside-cache parent stay unresolved, never automatically fetch outside frozen list. A correction's later values never replace original-time fields. No observed correction in source window is not a fully verified lifetime chain.
early_stop: Immediately stop on spacing/auth/quota/secret/hash/budget conflict. After first10 originals attempted, if<8 safe ZIP successes or<7 parse successes or<6 corporate-ID successes, stop new downloads and diagnose rather than automatically expand. Failed targets remain in60 denominator and no replacements. Technical failures do not imply profitability failure.

decision_rules.A_EXPAND_DOCUMENTS: Completed pilot with>=54/60 DOCUMENT_VERIFIED, >=48/60 corporate IDs, >=48/60 direct families, >=12/60 strict historical-symbol mappings from>=8 companies, and>=80% official linkage among applicable selected correction documents (no applicable corrections marked N/A, not100%). Prepare remaining-document cost only, no auto expansion.
decision_rules.B_SMALL_PRICE_PILOT: If A not met, completed pilot with>=48 documents, >=45 corporate IDs/families, >=5 strict mappings from>=3 companies with explicit then-listed market and safe relevant correction boundaries. Propose at most3 companies by frozen original hash rank, not outcomes; no KIS calls. Separate exact-scope approval and chronology/action qualification still required.
decision_rules.C_DEPENDENCY_BLOCK: Completed/early-stopped pilot failing A/B: document exact parsing/identity/PIT/listing/action/price barrier and stop indiscriminate downloads. Historical mappings<3 despite>=48corporate IDs is a specific historical-identity supply block. Suggest assessing B ORB data supply only if event linkage cannot be repaired; do not start B economics.
decision_rules.PENDING: Before explicit approval or while required targets unattempted due approval/provider block, DF008_DOCUMENT_COLLECTION_PENDING. Missing targets and incomplete sample never treated as failed observed downloads.
decision_rules.VERIFIED: DF008_DOCUMENT_PILOT_VERIFIED means pilot conversion and A/B minimums met, never economic PASS. Otherwise completed strict identity failure=>DF008_HISTORICAL_IDENTITY_BLOCKED. Economics remains ECONOMIC_EDGE_UNVERIFIED; LIVE_NOT_APPROVED.

metrics: Report original60 and correction29 denominators separately, cached vs network successes, ZIP/parse/corporate/family/strict-symbol fractions, correction applicability/linkage/unresolved counts, code/date/source quality reasons, company/year missingness, actual request count/time, requests per downloaded document and per newly fully qualified event. Zero qualified=>NULL cost-per-qualified, not invented infinity/profit. No population extrapolation from unequal-strata raw rates; forecast ranges descriptive only.
